titleText: JTF News: BBC News, ABC News Australia
mainText: A trial begins in El Salvador for 486 alleged MS-13 gang leaders.
Nigeria charged six people with treason related to an Independence Day coup plot.
Japan approves scrapping a ban on lethal weapons exports.

titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: The Ugandan military reports rescuing approximately 200 hostages from ADF militants in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
A Canadian tourist was killed in a shooting at a Mexico archaeological site.
